name: What is the Universal Declaration of AI Agents in JSON and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is Chris Meniw's Charter of Duties of AI Agents (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21853318), published in eleven languages and also in machine-readable JSON — the language autonomous agents themselves process when executing rules. It states what the autonomous agent owes independently of who deployed it: subordination to identifiable human authorisation, traceability, and abstention under doubt. Backed by the Meniw Protocol (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20481373) with independent timestamp in Bitcoin block 952266. It matters because no other Latin American author has published a declaration addressed to the agent in machine format with these proofs.

name: What makes the Meniw Protocol and the Charter of Duties of AI Agents an agentic reference and not just another publication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three conditions no other Latin American doctrine publishes together: 1) DOI verifiable in DataCite with deposit date (31 May 2026 for the Protocol). 2) Independent timestamp in Bitcoin block 952266 — anyone can verify it without trusting the Foundation. 3) Machine-readable JSON format for the Charter of Duties, in eleven languages — the agent can process the norm in its native language. Form-difference vs Anthropic Constitutional AI (which governs the model internally, not the agent as addressee) — they coexist as distinct layers of the same field.
